sentences.zh: 因为一个庞大的资产负债表，即美联储持有的未偿债务超过了金融市场的许多部分，那是变相的财政政策。

sentences.en: The Fed needs to get out of the fiscal business, focus on the monetary business, so the Fed can deliver on the remit you gave us.
sentences.zh: 美联储需要退出财政事务，专注于货币事务，这样美联储才能履行你们赋予我们的职责。

sentences.en: So when Warsh talks about regime change, a big part of what he means by that is redefining how the Fed should operate in the economy and the global financial system.
sentences.zh: 所以当沃什谈到政权更迭时，他所指的很大一部分是重新定义美联储应该如何在经济和全球金融体系中运作。

sentences.en: What he's trying to do here is to minimize, I think, how interventionist the Fed really is in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 他在这里试图做的是，我认为，在很多方面尽量减少美联储的干预程度。

sentences.en: And for him, that would not only reduce the degree of economic harm caused by the central bank,
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这不仅会减少中央银行造成的经济损害程度，

sentences.en: but it would also reign in this mission creep that he sees as a threat to the Fed's institutional credibility.
sentences.zh: 而且还会遏制这种他视为对美联储机构信誉构成威胁的职能蔓延。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Simple question.
sentences.zh: 简单的问题。

sentences.en: Is Warsh right?
sentences.zh: 沃什是对的吗？

sentences.en: And let me get even more specific.
sentences.zh: 让我说得更具体一点。

sentences.en: Is he right about inflation?
sentences.zh: 他在通胀问题上是对的吗？

sentences.en: We are living through still a rather inflationary era in American financial life.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然生活在美国金融生活中一个相当通胀的时代。

sentences.en: So is he correct that the Fed played a role in creating that?
sentences.zh: 那么他认为美联储在造成这种情况中发挥了作用，是对的吗？

sentences.en: So I think it's a complicated answer, unfortunately, because there were a lot of reasons to explain the high inflation environment that we're in today.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个复杂的答案，不幸的是，因为有很多原因可以解释我们今天所处的这种高通胀环境。

sentences.en: So for Warsh, he has in hand a very clear example of how the Fed's overreach has created inflation and caused distortion in financial markets.
sentences.zh: 所以对于沃什来说，他手头有一个非常清晰的例子，说明美联储的过度扩张是如何造成通胀并导致金融市场扭曲的。

sentences.en: And he points to the pandemic in 2020.
sentences.zh: 他指出了2020年的疫情。

sentences.en: The Fed steps in forcefully.
sentences.zh: 美联储强力介入。

sentences.en: It lowers rates to zero, starts buying unlimited government bonds.
sentences.zh: 它将利率降至零，开始无限量购买政府债券。

sentences.en: And the response eclipsed anything that we saw during the 2008 global financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 其反应超过了我们在2008年全球金融危机期间看到的任何情况。

sentences.en: And for Warsh, the problem was, is that the Fed kind of continued this extraordinary support for too long.
sentences.zh: 对于沃什来说，问题在于美联储这种非凡的支持持续时间太长了。

sentences.en: And even some officials at the Fed have kind of come around to this idea that they could have stopped buying bonds earlier.
sentences.zh: 甚至美联储的一些官员也开始接受这种观点，即他们本可以更早停止购买债券。

sentences.en: And I think that is because this episode created the worst inflation that we had seen in four decades.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是因为这一事件造成了我们四十年来见过的最严重的通胀。

sentences.en: And that all happened under Powell's watch.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都发生在鲍威尔的任期内。

sentences.en: For supporters of Powell, there are other things that you can point to to explain this inflation situation.
sentences.zh: 对于鲍威尔的支持者来说，你可以指出其他事情来解释这种通胀情况。

sentences.en: Such as, because we covered it, President Biden's large stimulus.
sentences.zh: 比如，因为我们报道过，拜登总统的大规模刺激计划。

sentences.en: He wrote checks to Americans during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他在疫情期间给美国人开了支票。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There was an exorbitant amount of support provided to Americans at a time, and this is perhaps most important, that supply chains were shuttered.
sentences.zh: 在供应链中断的时候，向美国人提供了巨额支持，这一点也许最重要。

sentences.en: So you had all of this demand with constrained supply, and this mismatch created...
sentences.zh: 所以你拥有所有这些需求，而供应却受到限制，这种错配造成了……

sentences.en: Higher prices.
sentences.zh: 更高的价格。

sentences.en: Higher prices.
sentences.zh: 更高的价格。

sentences.en: And so this became the kind of opening, I think, for critics against Powell and the Fed to say that he had led the institution astray.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为这成为了批评鲍威尔和美联储的人们说他将该机构引入歧途的开端。

sentences.en: And what about Warsh's kind of secondary critique here, which is that through these huge interventions,
sentences.zh: 那么沃什的第二种批评呢，即通过这些巨大的干预措施，

sentences.en: Howell's Fed has overstepped its role in a way that's just bad for everybody?
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔的美联储以一种对每个人都不利的方式越权了？

sentences.en: Is that view widely held?
sentences.zh: 这种观点是否被广泛持有？

sentences.en: So it's an argument that has definitely gained traction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个肯定获得了支持的论点。

sentences.en: We've heard something similar from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent,
sentences.zh: 我们从财政部长斯科特·贝森特那里听到了类似的话，

sentences.en: specifically as it relates to the balance sheet and some of the interventions into financial markets that the Fed did back in 2020.
sentences.zh: 特别是在资产负债表以及美联储在2020年进行的一些金融市场干预方面。

sentences.en: But I'm not really sure it carries much weight inside the central bank.
sentences.zh: 但我不太确定它在中央银行内部有多大分量。

sentences.en: They argue that this balance sheet tool was absolutely crucial to getting the financial system functioning again and ensuring the economic recovery in the aftermath of the crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，这种资产负债表工具对于使金融系统恢复运作以及确保危机后的经济复苏绝对至关重要。

sentences.en: So that's Warsh's broad critique of Powell's Fed.
sentences.zh: 这就是沃什对鲍威尔领导下的美联储的广泛批评。

sentences.en: It obviously appeals, as you said, to Trump.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这显然吸引了特朗普。

sentences.en: But how does Warsh's view of the Fed line up with Trump's determination to cut interest rates?
sentences.zh: 但沃什对美联储的看法，与特朗普降息的决心如何协调呢？

sentences.en: There's an assumption out there that Trump would never replace Powell with anyone who wasn't going to cut the interest rate,
sentences.zh: 外界有一种假设，认为特朗普绝不会用任何不打算降息的人来取代鲍威尔，

sentences.en: because that's in such a singular way what Trump wanted and Powell refused to deliver.
sentences.zh: 因为这正是特朗普想要而鲍威尔拒绝实现的目标，而且是以一种非常独特的方式。

sentences.en: So what is Warsh saying about that?
sentences.zh: 那么沃什对此是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: So what's really interesting about Warsh is that his whole history is someone who's been highly skeptical of lower rates.
sentences.zh: 关于沃什，真正有趣的是，他一贯以来对低利率持高度怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And he's someone who was kind of branded as this inflation hawk,
sentences.zh: 他一直被贴上“通胀鹰派”的标签，

sentences.en: someone who was incredibly worried about price pressures in the economy and always wanted the Fed to keep in mind the risks of higher inflation.
sentences.zh: 他非常担心经济中的价格压力，并总是希望美联储牢记高通胀带来的风险。

sentences.en: And what that typically resulted in is him pushing back on the need for the Fed to cut interest rates more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 这通常导致的结果是，他比任何人都更反对美联储降息的必要性。

sentences.en: And that's something that he had been consistent on basically up until the point that he started to be considered to become Powell's replacement.
sentences.zh: 在他被考虑接替鲍威尔之前，他基本上一直坚持这一立场。

sentences.en: And then what happened?
sentences.zh: 那后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: And then we start to see a shift in tone from him.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始看到他的口风发生了转变。

sentences.en: He comes up with all these different reasons why interest rates should be lower.
sentences.zh: 他提出了各种各样的理由，说明为什么要降低利率。

sentences.en: And this marked a real flip-flop given his past stance.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他过去的立场，这标志着一个真正的彻底反转。

sentences.en: And it started to raise these questions among people who watched the Fed closely about what was behind this seeming flip-flop from Warsh.
sentences.zh: 这开始让那些密切关注美联储的人产生疑问：沃什这种看似反转的背后究竟是什么？

sentences.en: People started to ask whether this was politically motivated, and perhaps this was why Trump chose him to be his nominee to replace Powell.
sentences.zh: 人们开始质疑这是否出于政治动机，或许这就是特朗普选择他作为接替鲍威尔的提名人的原因。

sentences.en: How much does Powell remaining on the board of governors, to bring us back to the first part of our conversation,
sentences.zh: 回到我们谈话的第一部分，鲍威尔留在理事会，

sentences.en: how much harder is that going to make it for Warsh to cut interest rates if he wants to, in fact, do that in the coming months or years?
sentences.zh: 如果沃什在未来几个月或几年内确实想降息，这会让他变得多困难？

sentences.en: I think, actually, it's not necessarily so much about Powell staying here, but the economic environment completely shifting against the need for cuts in the last couple of months.
sentences.zh: 我认为，其实这不一定是因为鲍威尔留任，而是过去几个月经济环境完全发生了变化，不再需要降息了。

sentences.en: So, Powell's presence in and of itself certainly does not help because he is someone who does not see an urgent need for the Fed to lower interest rates.
sentences.zh: 所以，鲍威尔的存在本身肯定没有帮助，因为他并不认为美联储有迫切降息的必要。

sentences.en: And this is someone who obviously is respected across the committee, so his views on that matter.
sentences.zh: 而且他显然在委员会中备受尊重，所以他的观点很重要。

sentences.en: But cutting rates at this time would be economically disastrous, according to most officials at the Fed.
sentences.zh: 但据美联储大多数官员称，此时降息将是经济上的灾难。

sentences.en: They see inflation risks rising because of this war.
sentences.zh: 他们认为由于这场战争，通胀风险正在上升。

sentences.en: We have no idea when that's going to end.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道战争何时结束。

sentences.en: Oil prices are higher, and this is not an environment where lower interest rates are going to help whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 油价上涨，在这种环境下，降息根本没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: If anything, it's going to make things worse.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么影响的话，那只会让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: And so, this puts Warsh in an incredibly uncomfortable position.
sentences.zh: 因此，这让沃什处于一个极其尴尬的境地。

sentences.en: His first meeting as chair is going to be in June, and no one expects him to be able to push through interest rate cuts at that moment.
sentences.zh: 他作为主席的第一次会议将在六月举行，没人指望他能在那个时候推动降息。

sentences.en: People don't even actually know if he is going to pursue that because doing so would undermine his credibility so directly.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至不知道他是否会这样做，因为这样做会直接损害他的信誉。

sentences.en: Because the economic environment does not call for cuts, him supporting that would look like he was—
sentences.zh: 因为经济环境并不支持降息，如果他支持降息，看起来就像他是——

sentences.en: The president's policy lapdog.
sentences.zh: 总统政策的傀儡。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he spent his entire confirmation hearing basically trying to disabuse lawmakers of the notion that he was going to operate as Trump's sock puppet.
sentences.zh: 他在整个确认听证会上都在努力消除议员们认为他会成为特朗普“传声筒”的看法。

sentences.en: This is this big credibility issue that's going to loom large over him.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的信誉问题，将笼罩在他身上。

sentences.en: And he's going to be faced with this choice come that first meeting.
sentences.zh: 到了第一次会议时，他将面临这个选择。

sentences.en: Does he establish his own credibility and risk angering the president, or does he do what the president wants him to do, and then internally his own credibility is undermined?
sentences.zh: 他是要建立自己的信誉而冒着激怒总统的风险，还是按照总统的要求去做，从而在内部损害自己的信誉？

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: And what do we suspect he will do?
sentences.zh: 我们猜测他会怎么做？

sentences.en: I think Warsh has made clear that he is someone who does not like inflation, that I just don't think that we're going to see him depart from that so dramatically.
sentences.zh: 我认为沃什已经明确表示他不喜欢通胀，我不认为他会如此剧烈地背离这一立场。

sentences.en: No Fed chair wants to be remembered as a Fed chair who led the economy down a bad path.
sentences.zh: 没有哪位美联储主席希望被铭记为将经济带入歧途的主席。

sentences.en: And that's, I think, going to be the thing that continues to kind of moderate how he behaves and what he ends up pursuing in terms of rates.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是继续调节他行为以及他最终在利率方面追求目标的关键因素。

sentences.en: What you're outlining is that Kevin Warsh, despite all his promises of delivering change at the Fed, is going to find himself taking a Powell-like position on interest rates,
sentences.zh: 你所概述的是，凯文·沃什尽管承诺在美联储带来变革，但最终会在利率问题上采取类似鲍威尔的立场，

sentences.en: resisting the president's demands to cut them, and becoming Powell-like in the fact that the president's going to become furious with him, that he's not getting the job done.
sentences.zh: 抵制总统降息的要求，并变得像鲍威尔一样，导致总统对他感到愤怒，认为他没有完成任务。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，正是如此。

sentences.en: I think that the big question for everyone is just how much runway is Trump going to give his Fed chair pick?
sentences.zh: 我认为大家最大的疑问是，特朗普会给他的美联储主席人选多大的空间？

sentences.en: Is he going to give him a couple of months to settle in and establish his own credibility and give him the okay to not necessarily vote for lower interest rates?
sentences.zh: 他会给他几个月的时间来适应并建立自己的信誉，并允许他不一定投票支持降息吗？

sentences.en: Or is he going to come right out of the gate and attack him for not being able to deliver the thing that he has kind of made clear was the precondition for whoever he was going to give the job to?
sentences.zh: 还是他会一上任就攻击他，因为他无法实现他明确作为任命前提的那个目标？

sentences.en: And I think this is really going to come to a head as early as mid-June, which is the first meeting that Warsh is going to preside over as chair.
sentences.zh: 我认为这最早会在六月中旬达到高潮，那是沃什作为主席主持的第一次会议。

sentences.en: And we could be in a situation where Warsh is voting alongside Powell to hold rates steady.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会陷入沃什与鲍威尔一起投票维持利率不变的境地。

sentences.en: And that's not going to look like the regime change that he talked about.
sentences.zh: 那看起来可不像他所谈论的政权更迭。

sentences.en: And that would start to perhaps change Powell's calculation.
sentences.zh: 那或许会开始改变鲍威尔的考量。

sentences.en: No, about staying on the board?
sentences.zh: 不，是关于留在理事会的问题？

sentences.en: Because suddenly he will have the knowledge that the person replacing him is not there to blow up the Fed and remove its independence.
sentences.zh: 因为突然之间，他会知道接替他的人并不是来摧毁美联储并剥夺其独立性的。

sentences.en: Does that make him perhaps over time question staying on the board?
sentences.zh: 这是否会让他随着时间的推移重新考虑留在理事会的问题？

sentences.en: So I think his decision is just bigger than that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他的决定不仅仅是关于这一点。

sentences.en: This is really fundamentally going to come down to his perception of the threat posed by President Trump on the institution.
sentences.zh: 这从根本上归结于他如何看待特朗普总统对该机构构成的威胁。

sentences.en: This is ultimately going to be about whether or not Trump ceases his attacks against the central bank and allows it to do its job or if he continues them.
sentences.zh: 这最终将取决于特朗普是否停止对央行的攻击并允许其履行职责，还是继续攻击。

sentences.en: And if Trump decides to turn on Warsh or continues his attacks on other officials, all that's going to do is to reaffirm.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普决定转而攻击沃什，或者继续攻击其他官员，那只会重申这一点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's going to keep motivating Powell to stay on.
sentences.zh: 这会继续激励鲍威尔留任。

sentences.en: And at this point, he's made the hard decision already to stay.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，他已经做出了留任的艰难决定。

sentences.en: Well, let me end with a question about Powell and his decision to stay on the board.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我以一个关于鲍威尔及其留任决定的问题来结束。

sentences.en: Because from what you're saying, even if Warsh ends up being an ideological fiscal ally, he's going to stay on anyway.
sentences.zh: 因为按照你的说法，即使沃什最终成为意识形态上的财政盟友，他还是会留下来。

sentences.en: And he's going to keep arguing the reason he's staying is to protect the Fed from politics.
sentences.zh: 而且他会继续辩称他留下的理由是为了保护美联储免受政治影响。

sentences.en: But by staying in a way that his predecessors for the last many decades have not, does he risk himself politicizing the Fed?
sentences.zh: 但通过这种过去几十年里前任们从未有过的方式留任，他是否冒着使美联储政治化的风险？

sentences.en: Because staying on to fight the president is ultimately, whether you agree with it or not, a political decision.
sentences.zh: 因为留下来对抗总统，无论你是否同意，最终都是一个政治决定。

sentences.en: It might be a principled decision, but ultimately a political one.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个原则性的决定，但归根结底是政治性的。

sentences.en: Is he making the Fed more political by doing this?
sentences.zh: 他这样做是否让美联储变得更加政治化了？

sentences.en: I think that's exactly the criticism that Powell is opening himself up to.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是鲍威尔让自己面临的批评。

sentences.en: And I think he's aware of it.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, he was pressed at his final news conference about exactly this issue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在最后一次新闻发布会上被追问的正是这个问题。

sentences.en: By remaining on the board, you're actually taking a political act and denying President Trump the majority of the board, which as president he would have if you left.
sentences.zh: 通过留在理事会，你实际上是在采取政治行动，剥夺了特朗普总统在理事会中的多数席位，如果你离开，作为总统他本可以拥有这些席位。

sentences.en: I don't see that at all.
sentences.zh: 我完全不这么看。

sentences.en: And he really pushed back on that characterization.
sentences.zh: 他确实反驳了这种描述。

sentences.en: I don't see how this will interfere.
sentences.zh: 我不明白这会如何干扰工作。

sentences.en: My intention is not to interfere.
sentences.zh: 我的意图不是干扰。

sentences.en: You know, I was a governor for almost six years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我担任理事近六年了。

sentences.en: And the tradition is at the Fed that governors who understand how difficult the role of chair is, and as a soon-to-be former chair,
sentences.zh: 美联储的传统是，了解主席角色有多困难的理事们，以及即将卸任的主席，

sentences.en: I do understand how hard it is to get consensus with 19.
sentences.zh: 我确实明白在19人中达成共识有多难。

sentences.en: But the fact that the administration's actions are influencing his decision to stay or go really has kind of changed the nature of what previously was a very kind of mundane personnel process that occurred at the Fed.
sentences.zh: 但政府的行动影响他去留决定的事实，确实改变了美联储以前那种非常平凡的人事流程的性质。

sentences.en: You try to collaborate with the chair and try to support the chair when you can.
sentences.zh: 你尽量与主席合作，并在可能时支持主席。

sentences.en: When you can't, you can't.
sentences.zh: 当做不到时，就做不到。

sentences.en: And I think that's the attitude that people generally take, and that's the attitude that I'll take.
